review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Read finding (framework remap), paper/CERTIFICATE.md, verification-manifest.txt, run_210B.log
Checked silent clipping in matrix_enum_multipass.cu and v6.1 hardening
Recomputed Dolgopyat profile stats from dolgopyat_profile_exact.csv
Reviewed multi-model prior reviews and revision-response

claim_reviews.claim: v6 reports Uncovered:0 for all d <= 2.1e11 in 6962.2s on 8xB200.
claim_reviews.evidence: run_210B.log ends Uncovered:0 / Time:6962.2s; manifest records hashes/hardware.

claim_reviews.claim: The 210B run is a certified no-overflow computational proof of coverage.
claim_reviews.evidence: v6 silently drops children when pos>=max_out and clamps frontiers to BUF_SLOTS. CERTIFICATE.md §4 is explicit that Uncovered:0 is conditional on no overflow, which the published log does not prove. v6.1 adds overflow abort + certificate, but certified suite logs are absent from this checkout.
claim_reviews.concerns: Strong computational evidence ≠ certified computational result.

claim_reviews.claim: ρ_η ≤ 0.771 and ρ(t)<0.68 for all t≥2 from the Dolgopyat profile.
claim_reviews.evidence: dolgopyat_profile_exact.csv: max ρ=0.75513 at t=1; among 19899 points with t≥2, max ρ=0.7278 and 203 points have ρ≥0.68. The second half of the claim is false against the project's own CSV.

claim_reviews.claim: Path-count representation CSV on [1,1e6] has no zeros; min R(1)=6.
claim_reviews.evidence: representation_counts_1000000.csv: 1e6 rows, zero zeros, R(1)=6. SHA a3a1a520…

claim_reviews.claim: Effective D0 ≈ 3.4e10 closes Zaremba with margin using MOW constants.
claim_reviews.evidence: Depends on non-effective/heuristic constant extraction and unfinished layers (property τ for all moduli, Galerkin transport, full Dolgopyat theorem). Prior o3/o3-pro reviews correctly refuse theorem-level acceptance.
claim_reviews.concerns: The remap from "proved" to framework is the correct public posture.

claim_reviews.claim: All-prime transitivity via Dickson classification completes a local-obstruction-free proof.
claim_reviews.evidence: Generators have det=-1, so SL2 wording is imprecise; the algebraic argument remains provisional AI-assisted writing, not an independent peer-reviewed theorem.

missing_references: v6.1 210B re-run with printed NO-OVERFLOW CERTIFICATE
MOW constant notebook with theorem-matching hypotheses
Independent group-theory writeup of ambient-group-correct transitivity
overall_assessment: The project's honesty in remapping "proved"→framework is commendable and necessary. The 210B Uncovered:0 log is a spectacular computational artifact, but CERTIFICATE.md correctly refuses to call it certified while silent clipping remains. Independently, the Dolgopyat claim "ρ(t)<0.68 for all t≥2" is contradicted by 203 points in the project's own CSV. This is a computational framework with real partial results and real gaps — not a completed proof of Zaremba's conjecture.
recommendations: Fix or delete the ρ(t)<0.68 for t≥2 claim using the CSV
Keep framework language everywhere (title/slug already partially remapped)
Re-run 210B under v6.1 and publish the no-overflow certificate
List the four remaining proof gaps as first-class open problems, not footnotes
certification_justification: Finite computational evidence and a partial analytic scaffolding deserve bronze as a framework. Gold/silver theorem certification is impossible while overflow, Dolgopyat wording, MOW constants, and property τ remain open.
